steps.title: Open the Explorer
steps.say: The **Explorer** lists every file and folder in your project. Click the top icon on the far left to show it. If you can already see it, I'll skip ahead.

waitFor.hint: click the Explorer icon (the top one).

steps.title: A badly named file
steps.say: This project has a file called **untitled.txt**. That's not a very helpful name. Let's rename it to `team.txt`.

steps.title: Start renaming
steps.say: Click **untitled.txt** once so it's highlighted, then press **F2**. (You can also right-click it and choose **Rename...**) The name turns into a box you can type in.

steps.title: Type the new name
steps.say: Only the part **before the dot** is highlighted, so the `.txt` stays. Just type `team` and press **Enter**.

steps.title: Renamed!
steps.say: Now it's **team.txt**. Same file, same words inside, new name.

steps.title: Now delete one
steps.say: There's also a file called **delete-me.txt**. Click it once, then press the **Delete** key. (Or right-click it and choose **Delete**.) Deleting removes a file, so be careful in real projects. This one is safe.

steps.title: Are you sure?
steps.say: The editor double-checks before it removes anything. Click **Delete** in the box.

steps.title: Check your work
steps.say: Two more jobs done. Press **Verify** in the lesson chip to check the rename and the delete.
